title: What Atmospheric Electricity Harvest Is
definition: Atmospheric Electricity Harvest: harvesting the planet's natural electric field.
description:
Atmospheric Electricity Harvest is harvesting the planet's natural electric field. It sits squarely in Future Energy Systems, the frontier where tethered collectors science becomes harvest logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are altitude access-scale. Societies that master harvest hulls early will shape fair-weather current practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why tethered collectors programs worldwide now treat Atmospheric Electricity Harvest as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Atmospheric Electricity Harvest needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Atmospheric Electricity Harvest
title: Real Research Today: Atmospheric Electricity Harvest
definition: Today's documented research behind Atmospheric Electricity Harvest.
description:
The road to Atmospheric Electricity Harvest is already being paved. The International Energy Agency tracks 500+ GW of annual solar additions in its net-zero scenarios. Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building SPARC, a compact high-field tokamak aiming for net energy.

Small modular reactor designs (NuScale, Rolls-Royce SMR) move through licensing worldwide. Together these programs form the tethered collectors foundation that Atmospheric Electricity Harvest will build on — the harvest logistics results, the fair-weather current methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as harvest logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Atmospheric Electricity Harvest
definition: Estimates Atmospheric Electricity Harvest readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Atmospheric Electricity Harvest components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a harvest hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Atmospheric Electricity Harvest operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Atmospheric Electricity Harvest installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 72867 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tethered collectors monitoring, harvest logistics redundancy, or fair-weather current maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Atmospheric Electricity Harvest Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Atmospheric Electricity Harvest: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Atmospheric Electricity Harvest — harvesting the planet's natural electric field.

Phase 1 — Prove (tethered collectors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (harvest logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (fair-weather current): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (altitude access): harvest hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and atmosphere-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
